title: Add host-controlled empty table presentation and row numbers
body:
Hosts need consistent empty tables and optional row numbers without changing stored view metadata or hiding loading, errors, or unknown server totals. This change adds opt-in React presentation props to DataTable, ObjectGrid, and ListView. Empty header/pagination suppression only applies to explicit synchronous empty rows or a settled successful response with an explicit zero total.

The real SchemaRenderer bridge removes these host-only options from authored metadata for the registered table/view aliases, while retaining explicit host overrides, DataTable’s existing row-number metadata, and unrelated renderers. Fixed-column offsets are remeasured when a hidden empty header returns. Package and guide documentation plus changesets cover the public props.

Validation: 205 focused regression checks pass; source/test type checks and builds pass for the four affected packages; ESLint reports no errors. The README example compiles against built package declarations. An independent review reproduced and then verified closure of the metadata-spread and documentation-snippet defects, including 18 additional real-bridge comparisons. Cloud Build & E2E, Live E2E, lint, and full documentation-link validation have since passed. The full Type Check job exposed an existing test-build dependency issue: ListView.recordCountPager.test.tsx imports plugin-grid source directly while plugin-detail declarations may not yet be built. That import and dependency configuration are unchanged from the base; the focused source/test type checks passed locally after dependency builds. This remaining CI issue is recorded for follow-up rather than reported as green.

This is the first reviewed extraction from the preserved table WIP. The original WIP bytes remain unchanged; GridField row editing and Forge business changes are outside this PR. This does not claim browser or cross-product business acceptance.
